name: Block: Pre-signed Authority Change
description: Blocks durable nonce transactions containing instructions matching known authority/admin-transfer fingerprints.
author: SecureCheck Security Team

rule.message: 🚨 CRITICAL: Pre-signed authority/admin change detected. Transaction BLOCKED.

name: Block: Pre-signed Transaction with Fund Outflow
description: Blocks durable nonce transactions to custom programs containing fund outflows.
author: SecureCheck Security Team

rule.message: 🚨 CRITICAL: Pre-signed transaction with fund outflow to custom program. Transaction BLOCKED.

name: Block: Pre-signed Admin Change
description: Blocks durable nonce transactions containing admin/authority-change instructions in logs.
author: SecureCheck Security Team

rule.message: 🚨 CRITICAL: Pre-signed transaction contains admin/authority change instruction. Transaction BLOCKED.

metadata.note: Only fires when logs are available (confirmed tx or simulation)

name: CRITICAL: Timelock Removal
description: Alerts when transaction sets governance timelock to zero, eliminating safety delay.
author: SecureCheck Security Team

rule.message: 🚨 CRITICAL: Transaction sets governance timelock to zero. Removes safety delay for emergency intervention.

metadata.reference: Drift Protocol March 27 multisig migration - removed timelock
metadata.note: Currently supports Squads v4. Extend to other governance programs as needed.

name: CRITICAL: Pre-Signed Squads Proposal
description: Alerts on pre-signed Squads V4 proposal creation or approval. Hardware wallets show Unknown Instruction.
author: SecureCheck Security Team

rule.message: 🚨 CRITICAL: Pre-signed Squads proposal detected. Hardware wallet shows 'Unknown Instruction' - decoded as proposal_create/proposal_approve. Proposal contains embedded instructions that execute later. Verify proposal content matches expected action before signing.

metadata.reference: Drift Protocol $285M exploit March 23-30, 2026 - Security Council signed proposal containing admin transfer
metadata.note: This catches the SIGNING EVENT where the victim signs the malicious proposal on their hardware wallet.

name: Alert: Squads Governance Action
description: Alerts on Squads V4 vault transaction executions. These are critical governance actions that execute pre-approved multisig transactions and warrant monitoring.
author: SecureCheck Security Team

rule.message: ⚠️ ALERT: Squads multisig governance action detected. Vault transaction executing pre-approved multisig operation. Review transaction details.

metadata.note: Catches legitimate governance actions including multisig migrations and parameter changes. March 27 Drift multisig migration that removed timelock would trigger this rule.

name: Alert: Pre-Signed Transaction Requires Manual Review
description: Alerts on pre-signed transactions (durable nonce) to custom programs. Hardware wallets cannot display custom instruction details. Manual verification required.
author: SecureCheck Security Team

rule.message: ⚠️ ALERT: Pre-signed transaction to custom program detected. Hardware wallet cannot display instruction details. Verify all instruction parameters and target addresses before signing.

metadata.reference: Drift Protocol $285M exploit - team signed their own instruction without verifying target
metadata.note: Instruction registry provides human-readable decoding. Alert fires regardless of whether instruction is in registry.
